messages:
Megan L: Quick heads-up — Sienna's onboarding tests this morning show p50 latency jumped from 120ms -> 210ms on their US-EAST traffic after the seq_len bump. Customer is worried about UX for interactive completions.
Arjun P: Thanks. Do we have per-model/token breakdown? looks like Llama-2-13B-epoch is heavy at long prompts.
Megan L: Yes — attach: perf snapshot link (private): https://redwood.internal/snapshots/sienna/4478 — main drivers: long prefix, few repeated prompts, low KV reuse. Also they're on Dedicated pool in us-east-1.
Taylor S: Two quick ideas: 1) Try int8 quant drop for the 13B variant; 2) Route short/interactive flows to a compact 7B tuned model. Both low-risk can reduce tail latency and cost.
Arjun P: Agreed. For 1) propose a canary: create quantized variant `llama2-13b-int8-q1` and route 10% of sessions for 48h. Monitor quality via the existing eval prompt set (sienna-ui-interact). If delta BLEU/accept_rate < 2% then expand.
Samir (deploy-bot): Canary config created: route=10%, duration=48h, metric hooks=latency,p99,error-rate,quality-hook(sienna-ui-interact).ID=canary-4478-q1
Megan L: Nice. For 2) routing suggestion: Use a prefix-based router — if input token_count < 512 send to `redwood-compact-7b-sienna` else to the main model. Could be a simple rule in Console routes page.
Taylor S: Add autoscaling guard for compact model to avoid cold starts during spikes (min replicas=2). Also propose a fallback policy: if compact model quality < threshold, fallback to primary but keep users informed.
Arjun P: I'll draft the action items: - create quantized variant & run canary (deploy-team) - set router rule in Console (CS + Taylor) - add metric dashboards and alerts for p50/p99 and acceptance delta (obs team) - schedule 30m sync with Sienna PM tomorrow.
Megan L: I'll capture these in the customer ticket and ping PM. Renewal note: Sienna is at risk if UX doesn't stabilise before their pilot next month. Framing: cost-neutral optimization (quant + routing) is a safer conversation than 'upgrade infra'.
Taylor S: I'll prepare a short enablement doc for Sienna: what to expect quality-wise, rollback path, and how we'll measure success.
Arjun P: One more: recommend prefix KV caching for repeated prompts — we've seen 12-18% token savings there. Add that as secondary optimization after canary passes.
Megan L: Great. I'll update CS board and @CXM for renewal heads-up. thanks team :thumbsup:
Taylor S: ping me when canary metrics are live, I'll review quality samples.
